            char * manpage_content_generate_options (const
              options_config_t * config)
          

          

            Generate OPTIONS section content. Creates formatted OPTIONS section
            from option descriptors, grouped by category with proper groff
            formatting.
          

          

          
Parameters

          

            config Options configuration with descriptors
          

          
Returns

          

            Newly allocated content string (caller must free)
